Maya (Eng Oncall): Handoff notes for tonight (non-incident). Quick TL;DR: low traffic window, rolling rollout of embed-cache patch scheduled at 01:00 UTC, watch for cache-miss spike on /v1/embeddings. No active incidents.

Josef (SRE): Thanks — which nodes will be targeted for the rollout? any canary first? :eyes:

Maya (Eng Oncall): Canary on ded-3 (zone-b), then 3-node rolling to the rest. Plan: apply patch -> warm cache -> monitor 5m. If 5xxs > 0.5% in 10m, abort and roll back.

Keisha (Platform): Note: metric `embed_cache_hit_ratio` has a gap from 22:10-22:25 due to metrics-agent upgrade earlier. That won't affect alerting config but will show a blip in dashboards.

Alex (Eng): I've got the deploy PR open (link: https://git.redwood/eng/infra/PR-482). It includes a small change to prefix eviction config: `max_prefetch_items: 120` -> `160`. Keisha, can you confirm this matches the platform safe threshold?

Keisha (Platform): Confirmed. 160 is ok for ded-3 during low traffic. We should revert to 120 after the spike window if we see memory pressure. I'll set a watch rule to notify at 78% mem.

Josef (SRE): Quick FYI: we had two noisy 429s earlier from a client ramp; rate limits are still set to 400r/min per token-api key — no change planned but heads up.

Maya (Eng Oncall): Action items for tonight: 
- Maya: execute canary at 01:00 UTC and ping here when canary completes.
- Alex: merge PR and have deployment ready (done by 00:50 UTC).
- Keisha: watch memory and revert eviction if >78% within 15min of rollout.
- Josef: monitor 5xx and 429s, escalate if thresholds hit.

Alex (Eng): Will merge by 00:40 so CI has time.

ops-bot: scheduled deployment: embed-cache-patch -> canary ded-3 @ 01:00 UTC. Reminder set.

Maya (Eng Oncall): What to watch: 
- `embed_cache_miss_rate` (expect small uptick during canary),
- `5xx_rate` on inference nodes (abort if >0.5% sustained over 10m),
- `ded-3 memory` (Keisha watch threshold),
- `client_429s` (Josef).

Josef (SRE): If rollback needed, recommended rollback command: ``kubectl rollout undo deploy/embed-cache --namespace=redwood-prod`` — keep me in the thread and I'll open a bridge if we see cascading errors.

Maya (Eng Oncall): No other changes. Leave any non-urgent questions here and I'll respond in the morning. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Alex (Eng): Acked, will post merge + deploy times.

Keisha (Platform): Also leaving a short note in the runbook about the temporary eviction bump so oncall in future knows why it happened.

Maya (Eng Oncall): Closing handoff. Good luck, night team. :sleeping:
